raw:
I fixed B1 on `feature/US-10-05` in two new commits, and the gates are green. The story's four test cases (TC-10-32 to TC-10-35) pass on the new head 4021353, run on a clean tree. Nothing was pushed (local run).

**The fix (B1):** before, with a time still missing, ticking All day never set the start. So a description with neither day nor time couldn't be saved ("The end date can't be read."), and the Repeats menu was empty.
- **Core** (`crates/core/src/editor.rs`): `follow_start` now sets the start at midnight when the event is all day and its time is still missing. The end then follows at the event's length.
- **App** (`crates/app/src/editor.rs`): the editor now calls `follow_start` when All day is ticked or unticked, so the box works whether the day is typed before or after it.
- **New test:** `all_day_chosen_for_a_time_a_description_left_out_starts_the_event_on_its_day` covers four cases:
  - neither day nor time, then a day typed and All day ticked: saves as an all-day event on 28 Oct and the Repeats menu has choices;
  - All day ticked first, then the day typed: saves;
  - only the time missing, then All day: the Repeats menu has choices and it saves;
  - All day unticked again and 11:00 typed: the end becomes 12:30.

**Non-blocking findings:** I fixed code N2 only (the unreadable-field messages are grouped again in `crates/core/src/texts.rs`). Code N1, spec N1 and spec N2 are left as they are. For spec N2, DEC-234 is append-only, so recording the scope there would need a new DEC.
